quests.instruction: You are packing for a snowy trip and want to be easy to spot on a white hill. Which jacket color is the best choice?
quests.hint: Pick the color that stands out from snow.
quests.explanation: Bright orange stands out against white snow, while white and pale gray blend in.
quests.funFact: Skiers often wear bright colors so they can be found quickly.

quests.instruction: You mix yellow and blue, add more yellow, then a little white. What do you get?
quests.explanation: More yellow and white give a light yellow-green.
quests.funFact: Adding a little white changes how bright a color looks.

quests.instruction: A tidy shelf has all the cool-colored boxes on the left. Which box goes on the left?
quests.hint: Picture the sea and leaves together.
quests.explanation: Teal is a blue-green, so it is a cool color.
quests.funFact: Warm and cool colors can be sorted into groups.

quests.instruction: A cat sneaks through tall dry grass. Which color of cat would be hardest for a bird to see?
quests.explanation: A tan cat blends with dry grass.
quests.funFact: Animals use camouflage to hide.

quests.instruction: Ana mixes red and yellow. Ben mixes blue and yellow. Who gets a warm color?
quests.explanation: Ana's mix is orange, which is warm.
quests.funFact: Ben's mix is green.

quests.instruction: Which statement is true?
quests.correctAnswer: Pale pink has more white than bright pink
options: Bright pink has more white than pale pink
Pale pink has more white than bright pink
quests.explanation: Pale pink has more white, so it looks lighter.
quests.funFact: White lightens colors.

quests.instruction: A child says, "I see red, yellow and blue stripes." Which colors can she mix to make green?
quests.explanation: Of the three pairs, only yellow and blue give green.
quests.funFact: Red and yellow make orange.

quests.instruction: A poison dart frog is bright red or yellow. Why might it be so bright?
quests.explanation: Bright colors can warn animals to stay away.
quests.funFact: Ladybugs use bright colors as a warning too.

quests.instruction: You need a mat color that will not show dirt easily. Which is best?
quests.explanation: Dark brown hides dirt.
quests.funFact: Doormats are often dark so footprints show less.

quests.instruction: You color a picture of a desert with a camel. Which three colors do you use?
quests.explanation: Sand is tan, sky is blue and a camel is brown.
quests.funFact: Deserts can be hot.

quests.instruction: Cottontail rabbits have tails like little balls of cotton. Which crayon should a child use for the tail?
quests.explanation: Cotton is white, so the tail is white.
quests.funFact: A cottontail rabbit has a fluffy white tail.

quests.instruction: You tie a bow on a green gift box. Which bow color makes the bow stand out most?
quests.hint: Choose a color that looks different from the box.
quests.explanation: Red is very different from green, so the bow is easy to see.
quests.funFact: Red and green sit far apart on the color wheel.

quests.instruction: You see a tulip field with one yellow tulip among many red ones. Why is the yellow tulip easy to see?
quests.explanation: It is a different color from the red ones.
quests.funFact: Different colors stand out.

quests.instruction: Which of these can you make with paint: pink, purple and orange?
quests.hint: Which colors can be made with paint?
quests.explanation: You can make pink with white, purple with red and blue, and orange with red and yellow.
quests.funFact: Mixing makes many colors.

quests.instruction: A hot pepper is green and then turns red. What does this show about color?
quests.correctAnswer: Colors can change as things ripen
options: Colors can change as things ripen
quests.explanation: Many fruits change color as they ripen.
quests.funFact: Pepper colors change.

quests.instruction: A traffic light in many places has red at the top, yellow in the middle and green at the bottom. Which color is at the bottom?
quests.explanation: Green is at the bottom.
quests.funFact: Different places may have different layouts.

quests.instruction: You have a gray rock, a white rock and a black rock. Which is darkest?
quests.explanation: The black rock is the darkest.
quests.funFact: Rocks come in many colors.

quests.instruction: A toy is lost on a sandy beach. Which toy would be hardest to spot?
quests.hint: Colors that match the ground hide well.
quests.explanation: A tan toy blends in with the sand.
quests.funFact: Beach toys are often bright so they are easy to find.

quests.instruction: You want a banner that is easy to read from far away. Which pair works best?
quests.explanation: Yellow on dark blue is easy to read.
quests.funFact: Contrast helps.

quests.instruction: A friend says all fruits are red. Which fruit shows she is wrong?
quests.explanation: A banana is yellow.
quests.funFact: Fruits can be red, yellow, green, orange, purple or blue.

quests.instruction: You mix blue and red and get purple. Then you add a bit of yellow. What happens?
quests.hint: Mixing all three colors makes dull colors.
quests.explanation: Adding yellow makes it duller.
quests.funFact: Painters keep colors separate.

quests.instruction: Which color pair would blend into a muddy river bank?
quests.explanation: Tan and brown blend with mud.
quests.funFact: Animals that live near rivers often have muddy colors that help them hide.

quests.instruction: A snow leopard is gray and white with dark spots. Why is this helpful in the mountains?
quests.correctAnswer: It hides among rocks and snow
options: It hides among rocks and snow
quests.hint: It may remind you of mountains.
quests.explanation: Gray and white fur blends with rocks and snow.
quests.funFact: Snow leopards live in cold mountains.

quests.instruction: Mix white and black. Then add a little blue. The color is...
quests.explanation: Gray with blue is bluish gray.
quests.funFact: Gray can be many shades.

quests.instruction: Which set of crayons would you pick to draw an autumn forest?
quests.hint: It may remind you of autumn.
quests.explanation: Autumn leaves are red, orange, yellow and brown.
quests.funFact: Leaves change color.

quests.instruction: You want your drawing to look like the middle of a quiet, cool lake. Which colors work?
quests.explanation: Blue and green are cool colors.
quests.funFact: Lakes can look green or blue.

quests.instruction: Mixing two primary colors can make green, orange or purple. Which of these can it NOT make?
quests.explanation: Pink needs white as well as red, so two primary colors alone cannot make it.
quests.funFact: Pink is a tint, which means a color with white added.

quests.instruction: A girl paints a sunset over the sea. She runs out of orange. Which two colors can she mix?
quests.explanation: Red and yellow make orange.
quests.funFact: She still has blue for the sea.

quests.instruction: You see a rainbow. Which color is on the outer edge?
quests.explanation: Red is on the outer edge of a rainbow.
quests.funFact: Violet is on the inside.

quests.instruction: A zookeeper paints a bright orange tiger on a dark green background. Why does it look good?
quests.explanation: Orange stands out against dark green.
quests.funFact: Contrast makes pictures pop.
